example_prompt: List the Cartflox payment operators available in Côte d'Ivoire for checkout session cmf3k2p1x0001abcd9e8f7g6h to build my own operator picker.

id.description: Session identifier returned at creation. Passed as a path parameter.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (`ci`, `sn`, `bj`, `ml`, `bf`, `tg`, `cm`, `gh`, `ng`, `ke`...) or country name. Without it, every active operator is returned. Passed as a query parameter.

code.description: Operator code at the gateway serving it (`ORANGE_CIV`, `wave-senegal`...). Read it, do not hard-code it.

gatewayId.description: Identifier of the gateway serving this method.

country.description: Country label, or `UEMOA`, `International`, `Global` for methods valid everywhere.

flag.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or flag emoji, for display.

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: Operator codes depend on the gateway serving them (ORANGE_CIV, wave-senegal...): read them from the response, never hard-code them.
Card methods (UEMOA, international) are returned whatever country is asked.
country takes an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (ci, sn, bj...) or a country name; without it, every active operator is returned.

Accepts the secret key or the public key, per the OpenAPI; the Test mode page describes the public key as only creating a session and reading its status, so call this with the secret key if the public key is refused.
logo is a path relative to the Cartflox site root, not an absolute URL.

Errors are an HTTP 4xx/5xx status with a JSON body { "error": "<message>" }. Transfer endpoints add a machine-readable code, and so do some other refusals (code test_mode on payment links, rate_limited on webhook resends). A 401 says Missing API key or Invalid API Key.
